manifest.name: dshtools-sensevoice-input
manifest.description: SenseVoiceSmall-powered local speech-to-text for the DSH Desktop input box: click the mic beside the composer, speak, and the recognized draft (with language/emotion tags) is written into the input.
manifest.author: dshtools

bundle.text:
# dshtools-sensevoice-input bundle patch.
#
# Applied over the dsh-web-app layer. This bundle contributes ONE host row
# (the plugin that owns the SenseVoice Python bridge and its HTTP routes) and
# relies on its `dsh.client` manifest (in package.json) to load the browser
# half that renders the mic button in the composer tool row.
#
# Only additive `insert` rows appear here (never override a shipped row).

- insert:
    # Host half: spawns a persistent Python (funasr + SenseVoiceSmall) process
    # over stdio JSON-lines and serves same-origin HTTP routes the browser half
    # fetches directly: GET /sensevoice/status, POST /sensevoice/transcribe,
    # POST /sensevoice/restart.
    - id: dshtools-sensevoice-input
      name: 'dshtools-sensevoice-input'

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/ilovedyou6666-hub/dshtools-sensevoice-input)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dshtools-sensevoice-input)
[](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

基于 [SenseVoiceSmall](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/iic/SenseVoiceSmall) 的 **DSH Desktop 本地语音输入插件**:点击输入框旁的 🎤 说话,文本自动写入输入框草稿,并显示语言/情感标签(如 `zh · NEUTRAL`)。支持 50+ 语言,全程本地 CPU 推理,音频不出本机。

- 🎤 composer 内嵌麦克风按钮,识别文本自动写入草稿(`inputActions.setDraft`)
- 🏷️ 语言/情感标签解析(`<|zh|><|NEUTRAL|>…` → 结构化字段)
- 🖥️ funasr + SenseVoiceSmall 本地推理,无任何云服务
- ⚡ 模型懒加载(首次 10–30s,之后单次几秒);Python 进程崩溃自愈
- 🌓 主题自适应 UI

**1. 准备推理环境(一次性,约 5 GB)**

```powershell
.\scripts\setup.ps1   # uv → Python 3.12 venv → torch/funasr → 下载 SenseVoiceSmall 模型
```

> 默认安装到 `~\.dsh-sensevoice`,模型缓存 `~\.cache\modelscope`;
> 也可自行用任意装有 funasr 的 Python,并通过环境变量 `DSHSENSEVOICE_PYTHON` 指定解释器。

**2. 安装插件(任选其一,重启 DSH Desktop 后生效)**

```powershell

readme.section: npm(推荐;已上架 DSH 插件市场,市场内一键安装同款)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dshtools-sensevoice-input

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ilovedyou6666-hub/dshtools-sensevoice-input
```

> 若 PATH 中没有 `dsh`,在 DSH Desktop 内置终端执行,或从 设置 → 插件市场 安装。
> 更新:`remove` 后再 `add`(强制刷新);安装后可在 设置 → 插件 中确认。
powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dshtools-sensevoice-input
```

```powershell
pnpm install && pnpm check && pnpm test    # 依赖 / 类型检查 / 测试
pnpm build                                 # tsdown → lib/(host ESM + client bundle)
pnpm verify:package && pnpm release:check  # 包契约 / 发布元数据校验
```

```
src/      TypeScript 源码(host:桥/路由/内嵌 Python;client:组件/音频/API)
tests/    vitest 测试
lib/      构建产物(已提交,github 安装免构建)
scripts/  setup.ps1 · verify-package · release-check

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 点击后 `HTTP 405` / `403` | 旧版时序问题,更新到最新版并重启 |
| 「无法访问麦克风」 | 允许 Electron 的麦克风权限 |
| `python_not_found` | 先执行 `scripts\setup.ps1` |
| `model_load_failed` | 模型缓存缺失,重跑 setup.ps1 的模型下载 |
| 首次识别很慢 | 正常:CPU 加载模型 10–30s,之后复用 |
详见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)(当前 1.1.1)。

A local voice-input plugin for **DSH Desktop** powered by [SenseVoiceSmall](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/iic/SenseVoiceSmall): click the 🎤 beside the composer, speak, and the transcript is written into the input draft with language/emotion tags (e.g. `zh · NEUTRAL`). Supports 50+ languages; inference runs fully on your CPU and audio never leaves the machine.

- 🎤 Inline mic button in the composer; transcripts land in the draft (`inputActions.setDraft`)
- 🏷️ Language/emotion tag parsing (`<|zh|><|NEUTRAL|>…` → structured fields)
- 🖥️ funasr + SenseVoiceSmall inference, no cloud services
- ⚡ Lazy model loading (~10–30s first time, seconds afterwards); self-healing Python worker
- 🌓 Theme-aware UI

**1. Prepare the inference environment (one-time, ~5 GB)**

```powershell
.\scripts\setup.ps1   # uv → Python 3.12 venv → torch/funasr → SenseVoiceSmall model
```

> Defaults to `~\.dsh-sensevoice` with the model cached under `~\.cache\modelscope`.
> Any funasr-equipped Python works too — point at it with the `DSHSENSEVOICE_PYTHON` env var.

**2. Install the plugin (pick one; restart DSH Desktop afterwards)**

```powershell

readme.section: npm (recommended — same as the one-click install in the DSH plugin market)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dshtools-sensevoice-input

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ilovedyou6666-hub/dshtools-sensevoice-input
```

> If `dsh` is not on PATH, run this in the DSH Desktop terminal, or install from
> Settings → plugin market. Updates: `remove` then `add` again. The plugin then
> shows up under Settings → Plugins.powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dshtools-sensevoice-input
```

```powershell
pnpm install && pnpm check && pnpm test    # deps / typecheck / tests
pnpm build                                 # tsdown → lib/ (host ESM + client bundle)
pnpm verify:package && pnpm release:check  # package contract / release metadata
```

```
src/      TypeScript source (host: bridge/routes/embedded Python; client: components/audio/api)
tests/    vitest tests
lib/      built output (committed — github installs need no build)
scripts/  setup.ps1 · verify-package · release-check

| Symptom | Remedy |
| --- | --- |
| `HTTP 405` / `403` after clicking | Pre-1.0.1 timing issue; update to the latest version and restart |
| 「无法访问麦克风」 | Allow the microphone permission in Electron |
| `python_not_found` | Run `scripts\setup.ps1` first |
| `model_load_failed` | Model cache missing — re-run the model download step |
| First recognition is slow | Expected: the CPU loads the model in 10–30s, then reuses it |
